comment: Folders and files a web project must contain. The configuration model creates them; the bootstrap guard enforces them.

folderMap.src/app (or the framework's routes): routes and pages; public shell and authenticated shell
folderMap.src/features/<feature>: one folder per feature named from the brief
folderMap.src/server: server-side module wiring; one file per active module

dependencyDirection: routes -> features -> components; features -> src/server -> providers. Components never import src/server or any database client.
healthRoute: src/app/api/health/route.ts returns 200 (adapt the path to the framework's routing)
architectureTest: tests/architecture.test.mjs fails when a UI file imports the database
